title: Vegan Vibes Turkish Soya Milk Icli Kofte
description: A savory and tender Turkish dish made with soya milk and featuring coconut cream. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the minced garlic for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes, until translucent.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped parsley, mint, and dill. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fine bulgur and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the soya milk and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the bulgur is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Form the mixture into small oval-shaped koftas and place them on a plate or tray.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to help the koftas hold their shape.
Cook the koftas in the skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly browned and cooked through.
